question: Why must revilers of Shiva and the Kula Bhairava be denied this teaching?
premises: The teaching must not be given to them
inference: The teaching must not be given to revilers of Shiva or slanderers of the Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may refer to the deity or the tradition
plain_english: Not to a reviler of Shiva, O goddess, nor to a slanderer of the Kula Bhairava.
